move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

It sounds like strong order intake makes firm commitment the basis for allocating additional capacity. If you can secure our full requirement, we are ready to commit long-term to support dependable capacity planning. What would you need from us to reserve that capacity reliably?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Our should-cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per 1 (cost:340010). Our recent orders for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM were at 29.89 per 1 (po:4500014337-10, po:4500014383-10, po:4500014436-10). Our demand forecast for Mechanical seal 24 mm is up +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 29.57 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message, which we have processed.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.
For the record:
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
A binding 36-month commitment at 23,400 units per year provides the necessary basis to allocate capacity reliably.
While we note your cost estimates, they do not reflect our current high utilization and operational parameters.
We accept your proposed volume, contract length, and lead time, but require a unit price of €31.70 to proceed.
Our Lieferzeit is 56 days.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
We will process your next message according to our standard procedure.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

It sounds like the binding commitment has resolved your capacity-allocation concern, while pricing remains the obstacle to agreement. We want that long-term certainty to support dependable supply and a sustainable partnership. How can you reflect the value of that commitment in your price so we can move forward together?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 30.18 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
